propositions: Three Copilot rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register due to invalid SKILL.md frontmatter: descriptions exceed 1024-char cap or contain unparseable YAML (unquoted colons).
SKILL.md frontmatter descriptions must be rewritten as folded block scalars and trimmed to <= 1024 characters while preserving skill invocation triggers.
A new deterministic CI lint script (check_skill_frontmatter.py) must validate all SKILL.md files for YAML parseability, description presence/length, and name format compliance.
The lint script must be integrated into the make lint target and accompanied by unit tests covering happy path and failure scenarios (over-cap, empty, unparseable, bad-name).
The four agent skills must pass validation: all frontmatters parse, descriptions are non-empty strings <= 1024 chars, and each skill's invocation trigger is preserved in its description.
